name: FLIGHT-003: Channel Authority Shrink & Scope Caps (#799)

channel_capability_ceilings.clamping: clampChannelCapabilities and clampCapability clamp raw grants by channel/binding ceilings (e.g. max_capability, default lead/member)

anti_escalation_and_scope_fences.isOrgAdmin_channel_guard: isOrgAdmin(auth) returns false for channel='im', preventing non-directory channel sessions from inheriting standing org-admin authority
anti_escalation_and_scope_fences.scope_confinement: Inbound mentions, status, and task creation remain strictly confined to visible squad and project scopes without ambient bypasses
anti_escalation_and_scope_fences.legacy_role_bypass_eliminated: legacyOwnerAdmin on channel sessions cannot bypass squad authorization
